description: This Python script encodes firmware files for MOXA IW devices by adding headers, computing CRCs, and encrypting the data with a XOR cipher. It processes partitions such as kernel, root, and userdisk, and outputs an encoded firmware image.
external_files: <none explicitly referenced besides reading input and writing output files>

methods.description: Adds a custom firmware header including metadata and CRC to the binary data.

methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with XOR and final inversion.

methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading the input firmware, partitioning, adding headers, encrypting, and writing the output firmware.
